# 🐛 Bugfix Pull Request

## 🐞 Issue Description
Describe the bug and its impact.

- What was happening?
- Expected behavior?
- Where did this occur?

---

## 🔍 Root Cause
Explain what caused the issue.

---

## 🛠 Resolution
Describe how it was fixed.

---

## 🧪 Validation
- [ ] Issue reproduced before fix
- [ ] Verified fix locally
- [ ] Regression tested
- [ ] CI pipeline passed

Evidence: (paste logs / screenshots)


---

## ⚠ Risk Assessment
- [ ] Low risk
- [ ] Medium risk
- [ ] High risk (explain below)

Mitigation strategy:

---

## 🌍 Infrastructure Impact
- [ ] No infra change
- [ ] Terraform modified
- [ ] Config updated

---

## 📎 Related Issue
Closes #

## ✅ Review Checklist
- [ ] No unrelated changes included
- [ ] Minimal scope change
- [ ] Tests updated if required
- [ ] Security reviewed
